question: Why does the rule "Use intention-revealing names" matter in a code review?

expected_rule_sections.heading: Use intention-revealing names
heading_path: Clean Code, Chapter 4: Meaningful Names, PR review rules
Use intention-revealing names

relevant_concepts: A name should answer why it exists, what it does, and how it is used. If a name requires a comment, it doesn't reveal its intent. Clear names beat short names, even when they are longer.
